item.title: IndiGo’s meltdown is a structural warning
item.description: Airlines are private firms. But aviation mobility is a public network good. India’s economic geography rests disproportionately on one carrier’s operational discipline. When that carrier stumbles, the effects ripple across GDP, not just holiday plans. The post IndiGo’s meltdown is a structural warning appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: The Bias of Being Biased
item.description: When rules are applied evenly but one side finds itself restricted more often due to its own misconduct, charges of bias quickly follow. Enforcement of procedure is portrayed as ‘discrimination’, and insistence on maintaining order is recast as ‘political hostility’. The post The Bias of Being Biased appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.
